```python
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    sep_col = next((c for c in range(w)
                    if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1
                    and grid[0][c] not in (0, 9)), None)

    if sep_col is not None:
        left = [row[:sep_col] for row in grid]
        right = [row[sep_col + 1:] for row in grid]
        return [[3 if left[r][c] != 0 and right[r][c] == 9 else 9
                 for c in range(len(left[0]))] for r in range(h)]

    sep_row = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                   if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] not in (0, 9))
    top, bottom = grid[:sep_row], grid[sep_row + 1:]
    return [[3 if top[r][c] == 9 and bottom[r][c] == 9 else 9
             for c in range(w)] for r in range(len(top))]
```

```python
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_col = next((c for c in range(w)
                    if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1), None)

    if sep_col is not None:
        left = [row[:sep_col] for row in grid]
        right = [row[sep_col + 1:] for row in grid]
        colors = set(sum(left, [])) & set(sum(right, []))
        shared = next((x for x in colors
                       if any(v != x for row in left for v in row)
                       and any(v != x for row in right for v in row)), 0)
        return [[3 if left[r][c] == shared and right[r][c] == shared
                 else shared for c in range(len(left[0]))]
                for r in range(h)]

    sep_row = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                   if len(set(row)) == 1)
    top, bottom = grid[:sep_row], grid[sep_row + 1:]
    colors = set(sum(top, [])) & set(sum(bottom, []))
    shared = next(iter(colors), 0)
    return [[3 if top[r][c] == shared and bottom[r][c] == shared
             else shared for c in range(w)] for r in range(len(top))]
```
